digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and RUF rule family
propositions: Enable the RUF rule family in Ruff configuration by adding RUF to [tool.ruff.lint].select.
Defer RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 globally via [tool.ruff.lint].ignore (intentional Unicode prose/UI content).
Remediate 179 actionable RUF diagnostics across src/rebar and tests identified by the baseline narrow-census command.
Verify that per-file-ignores contain no RUF-family codes and that extend-ignore is absent from the configuration.
Remove 374 stale RUF100 (unused noqa) suppressions under the full configured rule set after enabling RUF.
Extend test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert RUF family selection, exact deferral set, and absence of per-file RUF exemptions.
